$comment: Advisories accepted for the runtime dependency tree, with a reason and the date of the review. Anything not listed here fails scripts/audit-gate.js. The list is EMPTY in the submitted revision: after upgrading express to 4.22.3 and http-cache-semantics to 4.3.0 the runtime tree reports no high or critical advisory at all. The mechanism is kept as a safety valve, so that a future transitive advisory can be accepted explicitly instead of the whole gate being switched off. Reviewed 2026-10-27.
